name: Nicolás Pascual de la Parte - § 9 - Am 125
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 9. Welcomes the appointment of Andrius Kubilius, the first-ever Commissioner for Defence and Space, who worked jointly with the VP/HR on a white paper on the future of European defence within the first hundred days of their mandate, and recognises that some of the proposed solutions could be a good starting point for strengthening European defence capability; stresses the need for the EU and its Member States, acting in the interests of European security, to take priority measures and prepare urgent actions in order to meet alliance obligations which the economically strongest states have neglected for decades, notably with regard to the threat posed by Russia, and to bolster deterrence and enhance operational capabilities as a tool of defence in wartime, while meeting civilian and humanitarian needs, and thus leveraging the concept of ‘dual-use’;
